added.summary: New guide effect-files: every line an emitter (`type particles`), an effect material (`type effect`) and a composed effect (`type vfx`) takes, with its arguments, default and the elements that take it, written from the tables the parsers read, so the guide and the parsers never disagree. loading §5 and §11 point to it instead of their partial tables; the emitter's `events` line is documented for the first time.

fixed.member: type particles, type effect, type vfx
fixed.summary: A line a parser does not take is refused with the lines it does take (an emitter, an effect material, a texture's uv block, a vfx and each vfx element), instead of the bare name of the unknown line.
